xs=[-100,-80,-60,-40,-20,0,20,40,60,80,100]
ys=[2,2,0,4,5,39,5,3,0,0,1]
def interp(x):
    if x<=xs[0]: return ys[0]
    if x>=xs[-1]: return ys[-1]
    for i in range(len(xs)-1):
        if xs[i]<=x<=xs[i+1]:
            t=(x-xs[i])/(xs[i+1]-xs[i])
            return ys[i]+t*(ys[i+1]-ys[i])
    return ys[-1]
def prof(d):
    dd=abs(d)
    return (interp(dd)+interp(-dd))/2
def thick(y,p):
    n=int(300//p)
    total=0
    for k in range(n+1):
        c=k*p; d=y-c
        if -100<=d<=100:
            total+=prof(d)
    return total
print('Dividers of 120 plus useful p, QC same phase')

    f_lo=50/mn if mn>0 else 999
